name: The Adventures of E²
source:
Meet the unconventional duo; the smug, superior detective Esme & his partner, the hot-blooded rookie detective, Elio. 

The duo embarks on the twisted murder case of Cinderedge's beloved Formula 2 racing star. The two must face their own trials and tribulations during the case. One of heartache and the other of an endless stomach.  

Can they solve the case before the engine starts?

(Or before hunger gets the better of Elio?)

Welcome to the Black Cross Detective Agency
Are you tired of being nice? 

Don't you just want to go crazy

Join our agency:

(Esme x Elio = E²)
The Adventures of E² is a detective mystery visual novel game set in the steam-powered world of Cinderedge. Follow the two notorious detectives on their awesome adventure.  Come along for the ride and get yourself a steamdog at Steamdogs Express. 

Here's a coin to start your adventure!

[From [url=https://ultimatetruth.itch.io/the-adventures-of-e2]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
来认识这对不按常理出牌的搭档：自命不凡、总觉得高人一等的侦探埃斯梅，以及他的热血新人搭档埃利奥。

灰烬城深受爱戴的二级方程式赛车明星惨遭谋杀，两人接手了这桩曲折的案子。办案过程中，他们还得各自面对自己的难关：一个为情所伤，另一个的胃像无底洞一样填不满。

他们能赶在引擎发动前破案吗？

（或者说，赶在埃利奥饿得受不了之前？）

欢迎来到黑十字侦探社。
当好人当腻了吗？

是不是就想发个疯？

加入我们吧！

（埃斯梅×埃利奥＝E²）
《E²历险记》是一部侦探推理视觉小说，舞台是由蒸汽驱动的灰烬城。跟着两位名声在外的侦探去冒险，顺路到“蒸汽热狗快车”给自己来根蒸汽热狗吧。

给你一枚硬币，冒险这就开始！

［摘自[url=https://ultimatetruth.itch.io/the-adventures-of-e2]itch.io[/url]］
